snippet.title: Muldulamulom walkthrough
snippet.description:
In this video I play through my game Muldulamulom, designed in 72 hours for the Ludum Dare 40 game jam.*

You may play the game in your browser here, should you so desire:
https://mason-lindroth.itch.io/muldulamulom

*The final boss's death animation was created after the game jam.
